groove.verdict: the groove sits 0.3-1.04 mm outboard of the inner cheek's face, outboard of every bearing: its bending moment and shear are zero, so the groove costs the pin nothing; the pin's peak is at mid-span, where the counterbore's shorter outer bearing moves the outer reaction inboard and lowers it against pin_check. Cut 1 mm inside the cheek by mistake, the groove would read the 'misplaced' SFs; the machinist's drawing dimensions it from the head seat.

thrust.basis: ASSUMPTION WALK-MU: 0.2 x the dy95 y-z force; vendor ring thrust (McMaster DIN 6799)

sleeve_bearing.note: factored rows (2.4 basis); the 1 mm liner is backed by the PAHT cheek (confined): uniaxial yield is a lower bound. L6 = the first counterbore (2 mm), L8 = no counterbore.

head_check.note: the US2 pins are 7075-T6 (not Ti); Ti rows for reference

us_route_heads.pin_note: BL-058: the free drapes have no frame outboard of the stays, so they pass through the clevis's own outer face (face_rows < 0); the cloth tents over that face. choice.why: guided scatter 0.2 mm fits D5.8's 0.3 mm (and not D5.5's 0.15); freehand 0.4 mm fits neither: print the insert-setting guide (test_pieces/hip_insert_guide)

insert_guide.material: PAHT-CF as the frame (ASSUMPTION GUIDE-HEAT: the iron tip works inside the insert; replace the guide when a bore reads > 7.4 mm)
insert_guide.print: block face down, skirt up (no supports: the bores and the window are vertical)
procedure: 1. Guide on the boss, skirt over the D50 rim, pressed flat on the face.

2. START each insert through its bore: iron at the vendor temperature, push until the insert's top is level with the guide's top face (6 mm above the boss face; the insert is then 3.5 mm into the pilot with 6 mm held straight in the bore).
3. After insert 1: M5 x 12 + a 10 mm washer on the guide top, into insert 1, snug: the guide cannot turn; start inserts 2-8 the same way, let them cool 30 s each.
4. Unscrew, lift the guide off. FINISH each insert with a flat-faced tip: press it straight down the last 6 mm until flush with the boss face (the started axis guides it).
5. Straight-edge + 0.2 mm feeler: no insert proud, none more than 0.2 mm low (INSERT-SET).
6. Ti mount on: all 8 x M5 x 12 must start by hand through the D5.8 holes (first-article check of the scatter).

mass.print_basis: assembled print mesh BL-058 - the 6b0cde1 copy (outputs/bl058/before) x 1.06 g/cm3

assumptions.text: M5 x 35 / x 45 length within +/-0.5 mm (ISO 4759-1 grade A js15).
assumptions.settled_by: Caliper every bolt: US2 M5 x 35 must read 34.7-35.3 (tail room 0.5 mm, tip past the nut 1.0 mm nominal).

assumptions.text: McMaster 90153A214 (for a 3/16 in = 4.76 mm shaft) springs over the 5.0 mm pin and holds.
assumptions.settled_by: PIN-RET (a): 50 N push on the tail moves the pin < 0.5 mm; fallback 90153A216.

assumptions.text: The hairpin clip's straight leg stands <= 3 mm past the pin aft; the clip body (<= 13.5 mm) lies fore, within +/-3.8 mm of the pin axis in z.
assumptions.settled_by: Caliper one clip seated on a pin; PIN-RET (d).

assumptions.text: Hairpin clip 0.122 g (wire volume), E-clip 0.198 g (75 % of the annulus).
1.5 mm from the E-clip groove to the tether hole (3 x the 0.5 mm groove depth).
assumptions.settled_by: PIN-RET (a) on the US2 pin: 50 N push, the ring stays seated.

assumptions.text: A walking pin pushes on its retainer with <= 0.2 x the largest y-z pin force (the eye's pull along the pin bears on the cheek).
assumptions.settled_by: PIN-RET (b): every retainer seated after the T9 walk and the cycle tests.

assumptions.text: Kt 2.5 for the groove in bending (only used for the misplaced-groove sensitivity).
assumptions.settled_by: Not needed while the groove is outboard of the cheek (M = 0 there); PIN-RET (a) measures its position.

assumptions.text: The US2 tether's strand across the lug arm's bag face (1.5 mm cord) leaves no mark on B-01; the free drapes reach it (-0.6 mm, the bag rests on the arm there).
Inserts set flush to 0.2 mm low.
assumptions.settled_by: Straight-edge + feeler before the mount goes on.
Vendor CMM report or a pin-gauge plate.

assumptions.text: Set-insert position error 0.2 mm radial with the guide, 0.4 mm freehand (no published figure found).
assumptions.settled_by: First article: all 8 M5 x 12 start by hand through the D5.8 mount; pin gauge per insert.

assumptions.text: The PAHT-CF guide's bores survive 8 insert starts (the iron tip works inside the insert).
A 3 mm hex screwdriver blade sweeps a D4 envelope (3.46 across corners + 0.5).
